A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the particle/dye adsorption procedure is more effective for the improvement of PSP characteristics than the conventional procedure.
the CPVC and time response of the PC-PSS can be improved by using a new procedure for the particle incorporation into the binder layer.
the PD-adsorption is a useful procedure for embedding ceramic particles in the binder of PSP, and that the CPVC is a key factor for the improvement of PSP characteristics.

PC-PSPs can be used to control the coating film structure.
